title: UPSC CSE - Logical Reasoning - Relationship Puzzles
subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 1. Consider the following including the Question and the Statements: There are 5 members A, B, C, D, E in a family. Question: What is the relation of E to B? Statement-I: A and B are a married couple. Statement-2: D is the father of C. Statement-3: E is D's son. Statement-4: A and C are sisters. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above Question and Statements?
options: Statement-I, Statement-2 and Statement-3 are sufficient to answer the Question.
Statement-I, Statement-3 Statement-4 are sufficient to answer the Question.
All four statements together are sufficient to answer the question.
All four statements are not sufficient to answer the Question.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 2. P, Q, R, S, T and U are six members of a family. R is the spouse of Q. U is the mother of T and S is the daughter of U. Ps daughter is T and Rs son is P. There are two couples in the family. Which one of the following is correct?
options: Q is the grandfather of T
Q is the grandmother of T
R is the mother of P
T is the granddaughter of Q
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 3. A family of two generations consisting of six members P, Q, R, S, T and U has three males and three females. There are two married couples and two unmarried siblings. U is P's daughter and Q R's mother-in-law. T is an unmarried male and S is a male. Which one of the following is correct?
options: R is U's husband.
R is S's wife.
S is unmarried.
None of the above
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 4. A joint family consists of seven members A, B, C, D, E, F and G with three females. G is a widow and sister-in-law of D's father F. B and D are siblings and A is daughter of B. C is cousin of B. Who is E?
options: Wife of F
Grandmother of A
Aunt of C

questions.q: 5. Consider the following: A+ B means A is the son of B. A - B means A is the wife of B. What does the expression P + R - Q mean?
options: Q is the son of P.
Q is the wife of P.
Q is the father of P.
None of the above
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 6. Consider the following relationships among members of a family of six persons A, B, C, D, E and F: 1. The number of males equals that of females. 2. A and F are sons of F. 3. D is the mother of two, one boy and one girl. 4. B is the son of A. 5. There is only one married couple in the family at present. Which one of the following inferences can be drawn from the above?
options: A, B and C are all females.
A is the husband of D.
E and F are children of D.
D is the daughter of F.
